title: Inside the platform
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: the parts every data platform needs, drawn before the products under them, so that what's missing shows.
howto: Technology green is the platform: its eight parts, four along the way the data goes and four across them all, and a product under each, most of them Databricks. Blue is each domain's data products, and a gold tag is an owner in the business. Amber, a lantern's colour, is the road, and the part with nothing under it, drawn as a dashed outline.
